deviations.what: c2 S2 *Slot labels by verb* / *State 1 · typing*: slot labels are sentence case at label size ('From', 'For', 'From whom', 'What did you take'), untracked; the frame sets them as uppercase captions tracked 0.08em ('FROM', 'FOR', 'FROM WHOM')
deviations.reason: [shared] section caption — case and tracking. The theme tracks every role 0 (desk 193 (j)) because tokens.json carries no letter-spacing; the frame's per-role tracking (0.08em captions here, and below) needs a token before any widget can use it
deviations.authority: ADR 2026-10-05 §1; 07 §5 step 2 🔒 (labels by verb — wording unchanged); design/tokens/tokens.json (no tracking token)

deviations.what: c2 S2 *State 1 · typing*: the hero amount is drawn untracked; the frame tracks it -0.02em (and the empty-slot ⋯ placeholders 0.16em, which the app draws as icons, desk 193 (e))
deviations.reason: [shared] type tracking — tokens.json defines no letter-spacing, and a value in a widget would be a literal outside the sole token source; the theme's 0 (desk 193 (j)) removes Material's inherited 0.1–0.5 and matches the frame's untracked running text
deviations.authority: CLAUDE.md § Precedence (tokens.json the sole source for values); PLAN desk 193 (j)
